_note: Startup JS = the entry script in dist/index.html plus everything it imports statically. Checked by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs in CI. Raise only with a reason in the PR.
_raised: 1200000 -> 1300000 bytes in the 2.0 early batch: thirteen features that each fit alone (agent status, zero-setup signals, attention inbox, model chips, plugin API v2, turn history, Review Desk, Land sheet, worktree recipes, Done-When, Feature Tracks, session host) land together and add about 80 KB of startup code and English strings. 1300000 -> 1310000 bytes in the 2.0 final fixes: the answered-notification tracking every terminal needs from the start (which key a person typed, the first output after it; about 2 KB), on top of the 2.0-X batch that left under 1 KB of room. 1310000 -> 1322000 bytes for the 2.0 launch contract (models, effort, accounts): measured on main with the UI kit, it adds 14400 bytes of startup JS (1306072 -> 1320472), mostly the English strings of Settings > Agents, the refused-launch banner and the requested model chip, which sit in the startup registry like every other English string, plus the session-event and chip code every terminal needs; the banner and Settings > Agents themselves load on demand. 1322000 -> 1330000 bytes for the 2.0 task launcher (⌘N rebuilt, presets, morning view): its English strings (about 7 KB: every chip, menu, option, fallback note and the morning view) sit in the startup registry like every other English string, and a terminal's check that an open dialog holds the keyboard is startup code; the launcher itself loads on demand. Measured 1328801 bytes with the launcher on top of the UI kit and the launch contract. 1330000 -> 1338000 bytes for the 2.0-R1 batch: the estimated cost everywhere with the Review Desk's Changes section, and exact status from Claude, Codex and Antigravity with the OS layer below them, add 5756 bytes of startup JS on top of the task launcher (1328801 -> 1334557), mostly their English strings in the startup registry plus the status folding every terminal needs from the start. 1338000 -> 1356000 bytes for the 2.0-UI1 batch (the launch surfaces, the always-visible chrome, the Review Desk and Settings, and the dialog long tail on the control set, with the git locale fix): the dialogs that exist from the start (close a session, quit with working agents, an update, toasts, a crashed pane, the startup problem screen) and the sidebar, pane header, status strip, status bar, activity bar and scope bar now draw their buttons, chips, checkboxes, rows and close buttons with src/components/ui, so the control set (about 20 KB, every component; its stylesheet imports keep the whole set together) becomes startup code, less the bespoke markup it replaces, plus the new English strings of the four tracks in the startup registry. Measured 1334557 -> 1353945 bytes on the batch (the dialog track alone measured 1350999, the chrome alone 1338889).
